n136c96e957.headline: Jamaican business fuel anxiety surges on global oil spike
n136c96e957.summary: Businesses citing fuel and transport as their top input cost pressure rose to 18.3% in April from 9.7% in February, the Bank of Jamaica survey showed, as oil prices push inflation expectations higher.
n136c96e957.why: Oil prices feed into transport and production costs and inflation, which shapes central bank policy and the outlook for import-dependent economies.

n34e7ff463f.headline: BA issues update to passengers after cancelling flights to 7 major destinations
n34e7ff463f.summary: British Airways has cancelled flights to seven major destinations, citing the ongoing war in the Middle East, and has issued an update to passengers.
n34e7ff463f.why: British Airways is the flag carrier of the UK and part of IAG, and route cuts reflect airline exposure to geopolitical disruption and fuel costs.

n3242d3c785.headline: Former Spanish Prime Minister Zapatero is under investigation
n3242d3c785.summary: A Spanish court is investigating former prime minister José Luis Rodríguez Zapatero for alleged influence peddling and other possible crimes linked to a government airline bailout.
n3242d3c785.why: Government bailouts of state-linked companies use public funds, so legal scrutiny of how they were awarded affects investor confidence in public-sector deals and governance.

n17aa02f4e7.headline: Examples of where inflation eased in April – and where it accelerated
n17aa02f4e7.summary: The main upward pressure on inflation last month was a sharp rise in the cost of fuel. The article gives examples of where prices eased and where they accelerated.
n17aa02f4e7.why: Consumer price inflation shapes Bank of England rate decisions and gilt yields. Fuel is a volatile component that often drives short-term swings in headline inflation.

nb1a6a4c508.headline: Inflation drops back by more than forecast as energy offsets Iran war fuel hit
nb1a6a4c508.summary: The Office for National Statistics said UK consumer price inflation fell to 2.8% in April from 3.3% in March, with energy offsetting the fuel price hit from the Iran war.
nb1a6a4c508.why: UK inflation readings shape Bank of England interest rate decisions, which affect gilt yields and sterling.

n4235cfdf2f.headline: Google I/O 2026: It’s AI everywhere, from Gemini upgrades to smart glasses
n4235cfdf2f.summary: Google's I/O 2026 event offered few dramatic hardware reveals but showed Gemini being woven more deeply into Google's ecosystem, including smart glasses.
n4235cfdf2f.why: Alphabet's product and AI strategy influences its advertising, cloud and AI revenue prospects.

n1f214cb7c1.headline: Treasurer blames 'misinformation' for war on tax change
n1f214cb7c1.summary: Australia's treasurer accused critics of the government's capital gains tax changes of overstating their impact, blaming misinformation.
n1f214cb7c1.why: Capital gains tax settings affect investor behaviour, property markets and household investment decisions.

ne7be5f4472.headline: Ringgit firms against US dollar as stronger export performance lifts market sentiment
ne7be5f4472.summary: The ringgit strengthened against the US dollar as stronger export performance lifted sentiment. Malaysia's trade rose 28.6% year on year to a record RM336.73 billion in April 2026.
ne7be5f4472.why: The ringgit is Malaysia's currency, and trade data is a key indicator of export demand for an economy heavily reliant on trade.

n43a54ca46c.headline: Cyprus house prices and rents outpace EU average as market pressure builds
n43a54ca46c.summary: Cyprus house prices and rents are rising faster than the EU average, according to Eurostat's new Housing Dashboard. Households there remain less burdened by housing costs than many European counterparts.
n43a54ca46c.why: Housing costs feed into inflation, household spending and mortgage-lending conditions, which matter for banks and property investors.

n5cc59d8265.headline: Mortgage Rates Had Finally Eased This Spring—Now They’re Surging Again
n5cc59d8265.summary: Average 30-year US mortgage rates have risen to their highest level since summer 2025 after earlier easing this spring. The move follows financial market reactions to the Iran conflict.
n5cc59d8265.why: Mortgage rates track longer-term Treasury yields and shape housing affordability and demand in the US economy.

n7b1fc67318.headline: NPS warns uncertainty remains high despite record returns
n7b1fc67318.summary: South Korea's National Pension Service said uncertainty in global financial markets remains elevated, even after the fund posted a third straight record return. The comments came on Wednesday.
n7b1fc67318.why: The National Pension Service is one of the world's largest pension funds, and its allocations influence Korean and global markets.

n707743e0f0.headline: Keir Starmer confirms huge new change for UK petrol and diesel drivers
n707743e0f0.summary: The UK government has confirmed a change to petrol and diesel rates for drivers. The rates were previously planned to increase from September.
n707743e0f0.why: Fuel duty is a tax on road fuel in the UK, and changes to it affect fuel prices, consumer spending and government revenue.

ne02ca46c9f.headline: Asda and M&S slam Government food price cap idea as ‘preposterous and idiotic’
ne02ca46c9f.summary: Asda and Marks & Spencer have criticised a government food price cap idea as preposterous, while a minister denied plans for caps but confirmed talks with supermarkets.
ne02ca46c9f.why: Marks & Spencer and Asda are major UK grocers, and price-cap policy would directly affect their margins and pricing.

n9762269afc.headline: Asda and M&S slam Government food price cap idea as ‘preposterous and idiotic’
n9762269afc.summary: Asda and Marks & Spencer described a government food price cap idea as preposterous and idiotic. A minister denied plans for caps but confirmed ongoing talks with supermarket chains.
n9762269afc.why: Marks & Spencer is a major UK retailer, and any price regulation of groceries would directly affect supermarket margins and pricing.

na4e7c36e5d.headline: Markets Crashed at Open, Clawed Back by Close - Here’s Everything That Moved on May 20
na4e7c36e5d.summary: Indian markets staged a dramatic intraday recovery on May 20 after crashing stocks at the open. The rupee hit a record low amid global headwinds.
na4e7c36e5d.why: The BSE Sensex tracks large Indian listed companies, and rupee weakness affects import costs, inflation and foreign investment returns.
na4e7c36e5d.why_moved: Stocks sold off at the open before recovering intraday, while the rupee hit a record low amid global headwinds.

n1c9d4d98d3.headline: Startup founder fears death of dream after tax tweaks
n1c9d4d98d3.summary: An entrepreneur claims recently announced tax reforms will stifle new businesses and remove incentives to pursue ambitious ventures. The reforms are not detailed in the candidate text.
n1c9d4d98d3.why: Tax settings for startups and investment affect venture funding and business formation, which matter to investors in early-stage companies.

n5a395fc74c.headline: Vingroup’s Green SM signs BEV deals with Philippine transportation companies
n5a395fc74c.summary: Vingroup's Green SM has signed battery electric vehicle deals with Philippine transportation companies. A combined fleet of up to 18,497 VinFast BEVs is to be deployed this year.
n5a395fc74c.why: Vingroup is a Vietnamese conglomerate whose VinFast unit makes electric vehicles, and fleet orders indicate demand for its EVs in emerging markets.

impacts.name: Vingroup
impacts.why: Fleet supply deals add to the group's electric vehicle sales pipeline in the Philippines.

ncf92bedc92.headline: SpaceX historic IPO filing reveals $5.5 billion loss, Elon Musk’s tight grip
ncf92bedc92.summary: A historic SpaceX IPO filing shows a $5.5 billion loss and Elon Musk's tight grip on the company. The listing is set to be of unprecedented size if it succeeds.
ncf92bedc92.why: SpaceX is a private aerospace company, and its IPO would be among the largest public listings, testing investor appetite for high-growth private firms.

nd3d8cd8e7f.headline: SpaceX reveals plans for what could be the biggest-ever initial public offering
nd3d8cd8e7f.summary: Elon Musk announced plans for one of the biggest public stock sales ever for SpaceX, a space company currently losing billions of dollars a year, according to a filing.
nd3d8cd8e7f.why: SpaceX is a private rocket and satellite company whose planned listing would be a major test of investor appetite for large space-sector equity.
nd3d8cd8e7f.why_moved: The planned offering is one of the largest share sales ever announced, which draws attention to capital demand and valuation for the space sector.

nf2b0b64473.headline: Sunway Healthcare cautiously optimistic on outlook
nf2b0b64473.summary: Sunway Healthcare Holdings said it remains cautiously optimistic for its current financial year, citing resilient demand for private healthcare and stabilising new hospitals.
nf2b0b64473.why: Sunway Healthcare is a Malaysian private hospital operator, so its outlook reflects demand for private healthcare in Southeast Asia.

nd1e754fafd.headline: Gold Rate Today On 20 May, 2026: Check Out Yellow Metal Prices of 24K, 22K, 18K Prices In UAE, Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Qatar, Saudi Arabia & Oman
nd1e754fafd.summary: Gold prices across the Middle East remained elevated on May 20, 2026, with global spot gold near record highs. Geopolitical tensions, inflation worries and safe-haven demand were cited.
nd1e754fafd.why: Gold is a widely held safe-haven asset, and its price reflects investor demand during geopolitical stress and inflation concerns.

n83a1107168.headline: Pakistan telecom sector faces investment pressure amid high tax burden
n83a1107168.summary: Pakistan's telecom sector faces investment pressure from a high tax burden that is limiting its capacity to expand and upgrade digital infrastructure, according to a report.
n83a1107168.why: Telecom operators need heavy capital spending on networks, so tax levels directly affect investment and service quality.

n91c00446dc.headline: NQ +0.8% into NVIDIA earnings and as Brent moves below $110/bbl; FOMC minutes ahead - Newsquawk US Market Open
n91c00446dc.summary: Nasdaq 100 futures rose 0.8% ahead of NVIDIA earnings, while Brent moved below $110 a barrel. FOMC minutes are also due.
n91c00446dc.why: NVIDIA is the largest AI chipmaker and a major weight in US tech indices, so its results influence broad equity sentiment.

impacts.name: NVIDIA
impacts.why: Its earnings report is the upcoming event that investors are positioning around.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n91c00446dc.why_moved: Futures gained in pre-market trade ahead of NVIDIA's earnings and the FOMC minutes, while lower Brent crude eased inflation concerns.

ndaf9f8ce9d.headline: Meta begins 8,000 global job cuts in Asian hub of Singapore
ndaf9f8ce9d.summary: Meta Platforms is cutting about 8,000 jobs globally as part of a restructuring to boost efficiency and reduce costs. The cuts mainly affect engineering and product teams, with some staff reassigned to AI initiatives.
ndaf9f8ce9d.why: Meta owns Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp and is spending heavily on artificial intelligence, so its cost decisions affect margins and AI investment.

impacts.name: Meta Platforms
impacts.why: The restructuring to cut costs and reallocate staff toward AI is the company's own action.

n052feadb49.headline: Govt relies on private sector as engine of growth in 2027
n052feadb49.summary: Finance Minister Purbaya Yudhi Sadewa said the government will optimise the private sector's contribution as an engine of economic growth. The statement concerns 2027 planning.
n052feadb49.why: Indonesia is Southeast Asia's largest economy, and its growth drivers shape regional investment and commodity demand.

n78c2c16806.headline: The SpaceX IPO filing is filled with AI bets, Starship dreams, and Elon Musk at the center
n78c2c16806.summary: SpaceX has made public the contents of its IPO filing, which is expected to be the largest IPO ever. Elon Musk would serve as CEO, CTO and chairman.
n78c2c16806.why: SpaceX is a private space launch and satellite company, and its public listing would be one of the largest equity offerings on record, drawing wide investor attention.

n753cb2892e.headline: Strong 1Q for EPF
n753cb2892e.summary: The Employees Provident Fund said its strong 1Q26 performance is unlikely to be sustained for the rest of the year. Investment income was boosted by portfolio timing amid global volatility.
n753cb2892e.why: The EPF is Malaysia's largest pension fund, and its investment returns affect millions of contributors' retirement savings.

n132667f55b.headline: Nvidia (NVDA) Q1 2027 Earnings Transcript
n132667f55b.summary: Nvidia has released the transcript of its first-quarter fiscal 2027 earnings call, covering the chipmaker's latest quarterly results and outlook.
n132667f55b.why: Nvidia is the leading supplier of AI accelerator chips, and its quarterly results are closely watched as a gauge of AI infrastructure spending.

impacts.name: Nvidia
impacts.why: The earnings call transcript contains the company's quarterly results and commentary.

ndac14c4dd4.headline: Amprius Technologies (AMPX) Shares Slip After Short Seller Raises Red Flags
ndac14c4dd4.summary: Amprius Technologies shares fell after Manatee Research published a short report alleging exaggerated orders at the silicon anode battery developer.
ndac14c4dd4.why: Amprius develops silicon anode lithium-ion batteries, and short-seller reports can prompt sharp share price moves and investor scrutiny.

n402461d852.headline: Bursa Malaysia stays lower at midday in line with weaker regional performance
n402461d852.summary: Bursa Malaysia traded lower at midday, in line with weaker performance across the region. No single stock or specific cause was named in the report.
n402461d852.why: Bursa Malaysia is the stock exchange of Malaysia, and its benchmark index reflects the broader health of Malaysian listed companies.

n8766a1364c.headline: Zydus Lifesciences shares soar 7% to fresh record high after Q4 results. Should you buy, sell or hold?
n8766a1364c.summary: Zydus Lifesciences shares rose 7% to a fresh record high after its January-March quarter results. The company reported a 9% rise in net profit, over 16% revenue growth, and a Rs 1,100 crore buyback.
n8766a1364c.why: Zydus Lifesciences is an Indian drugmaker with global generics and specialty businesses, and its quarterly results and buybacks are watched by pharma investors.
n8766a1364c.why_moved: Quarterly net profit growth of 9%, revenue growth above 16%, and a Rs 1,100 crore buyback lifted shares to a record high.

n8845c282a9.headline: HD Hyundai and TerraPower Sign Natrium® Reactor Supply Framework Agreement
n8845c282a9.summary: HD Hyundai has moved closer to commercializing next-generation nuclear reactors through a supply framework agreement with TerraPower's Natrium reactor. The deal was announced via PR Newswire.
n8845c282a9.why: HD Hyundai is a South Korean industrial group with shipbuilding and heavy equipment businesses that is expanding into nuclear supply chains.

nf77caeca9f.headline: OpenAI commits S$300 million to grow Singapore's AI capabilities
nf77caeca9f.summary: The Singapore government and OpenAI will collaborate on 'OpenAI for Singapore', a joint initiative to make the country a leading hub for applied, AI-native innovation. OpenAI committed S$300 million.
nf77caeca9f.why: OpenAI develops ChatGPT and related AI models, and its investments in national AI programmes shape demand for compute and talent.

n8f3e6d53b7.headline: China to work with US on slashing tariffs
n8f3e6d53b7.summary: China will work with the US on a trade council to discuss a framework for tariff reductions worth US$30 billion or more on each side. The measures were reported by Free Malaysia Today.
n8f3e6d53b7.why: US-China tariffs affect trade flows, supply chains and corporate margins across many sectors, and tariff relief can ease pressure on global trade.
n8f3e6d53b7.why_moved: A planned framework for tariff reductions of US$30 billion or more on each side reduces expected trade barriers between the two largest economies.

nf5fdd646ad.headline: S'wak approved 12 domestic investment project worth RM347.1mil in first quarter, says Deputy Premier
nf5fdd646ad.summary: Sarawak approved 12 domestic investment projects worth RM347.1 million in the first quarter of the year. The projects are mainly in services-related industries, according to the Deputy Premier.
nf5fdd646ad.why: Sarawak is a Malaysian state with a resource-based economy, and its investment approvals indicate the pace of diversification into services.

n4f13bd458d.headline: China wants AI to flourish, but not at the expense of jobs
n4f13bd458d.summary: A series of precedent-setting rulings signals that Chinese courts are being used to protect workers from job displacement caused by artificial intelligence. The Star reports on the trend.
n4f13bd458d.why: Court rulings on AI-related layoffs can raise compliance and labour costs for technology and manufacturing employers in China.

n8a8a5c2d17.headline: Indonesia’s Prabowo announces export controls for coal, palm oil
n8a8a5c2d17.summary: Indonesian President Prabowo announced export controls for coal and palm oil, with future natural resource sales to go through state-owned enterprises. The aim is to boost tax revenues amid economic headwinds from the Middle East war.
n8a8a5c2d17.why: Indonesia is a leading global exporter of thermal coal and palm oil, so export rules directly affect global energy and edible oil supply.
n8a8a5c2d17.why_moved: Export controls on two major Indonesian commodities would tighten supply channels to global buyers. The move is framed as a way to raise tax revenue during regional economic pressure.

n836b4b3ef6.headline: Malaysia's April trade hits record RM336.73bil on strong E&E exports
n836b4b3ef6.summary: Malaysia's trade rose 28.6% year-on-year to a record RM336.73 billion in April 2026. The growth was driven mainly by strong exports of electrical and electronic products, according to MITI.
n836b4b3ef6.why: Malaysia is a large exporter of electrical and electronic goods, a key segment of the global semiconductor and electronics supply chain. Trade data is a major gauge of Asian export demand.

n3cc9bbc4b6.headline: EPF front-loads first quarter income
n3cc9bbc4b6.summary: The Employees Provident Fund earned RM27.73 billion in investment income in the first quarter, up 51% from RM18.31 billion a year earlier. The figures cover the first three months of 2026 against 2025.
n3cc9bbc4b6.why: The EPF is Malaysia's main retirement savings fund and a major institutional investor whose returns affect millions of members' savings.
